title: Susan Pienaar | Wellness with Horses & Humans

texts.text:
🌿 Reconnect with yourself, discover new perspectives and explore the powerful connection between humans, horses and nature.

Susan Pienaar is the founder of Wellness with Horses & Humans, offering therapeutic, educational and wellbeing experiences in the peaceful natural surroundings of Redland Bay, Queensland.

With more than 25 years of professional experience and extensive postgraduate training in psychology, counselling, mental health, clinical supervision and equine-assisted psychotherapy, Susan brings together psychological knowledge, professional experience and a deep appreciation for the natural world.

As a Clinical Member of the Australian Counselling Association and the International Institute for Complementary Therapies, Susan is passionate about creating supportive, trauma-informed and neuro-affirming experiences that help people develop greater self-awareness, confidence, resilience and emotional wellbeing.

At the heart of her work is the unique relationship between humans and horses. 

Horses are highly responsive to their surroundings and social interactions, offering opportunities to observe our own behaviour, communication and emotional responses in a different way. 

Through carefully facilitated experiences, participants can explore personal challenges, develop practical skills and discover new perspectives in a non-judgemental environment.

Whether someone is navigating a difficult life transition, seeking greater emotional awareness, wanting to strengthen relationships or looking to develop their leadership and communication skills, Susan offers opportunities for meaningful personal and professional growth.

🐴 Why Work with Horses?
Horses are sensitive social animals that respond to body language, movement and changes in their environment. Their responses can offer valuable opportunities to reflect on how we communicate, relate to others and respond to challenging situations.

With professional guidance, these experiences can help participants explore their patterns of behaviour, strengthen self-awareness and practise new ways of relating to themselves and others.

No previous horse experience is required. Activities are generally conducted on the ground, with no riding involved unless specifically stated. Experiences are facilitated with consideration for participant safety and horse wellbeing.

🌱 Who Can Benefit?
Susan's services may be suitable for:
Adults, children and young people seeking personal growth and wellbeing support.
People navigating stress, anxiety, trauma or significant life transitions.
Neurodivergent individuals seeking supportive, tailored experiences.
Individuals wanting to strengthen emotional awareness, communication and relationships.
Families and community groups seeking meaningful shared experiences.
Businesses, leadership teams and organisations interested in team development and workplace wellbeing.
Schools, sporting organisations and community services.
Mental health practitioners exploring complementary support pathways.

texts.text:
Susan Pienaar -
Wellness with Horses & Humans

Equine-Assisted Psychotherapy
Psychotherapeutic experiences incorporating guided interactions with horses to explore emotions, behaviours, relationships and life challenges. These sessions can support self-awareness, emotional regulation, confidence and personal development.

Psychotherapy & Counselling
Professional psychological and counselling support to help individuals better understand their experiences, develop coping strategies and improve emotional and relational wellbeing.

Trauma-Informed & Neuro-Affirming Support
Supportive experiences designed with consideration for neurodivergent adults, children and young people, with a focus on self-awareness, emotional regulation, social skills, communication, relationships and independence.

Corporate Wellbeing & Team Development
Nature-based programs for businesses, leadership groups and organisations. Working alongside horses offers teams opportunities to explore communication, trust, collaboration, leadership and workplace relationships.

Workshops & Group Experiences
Facilitated group experiences exploring themes such as mindfulness, resilience, wellbeing, personal development and connection. Programs can be tailored to the needs and goals of the group.

Retreats & Immersive Experiences
Opportunities to step away from everyday demands and reconnect with nature through equine-assisted experiences, guided activities, reflection and wellbeing practices.


💚 Pricing & Funding
Fees are determined by the program and individual requirements.

Individual services: Private fees apply and depend on the program and individual needs.

Group workshops, retreats and corporate programs: Contact Susan to discuss your requirements and receive a tailored quote.

NDIS and third-party funding: Funding may be available depending on individual plans, goals and eligibility.

Medicare: The organisation states that it does not currently participate in the Medicare rebate program or Mental Health Care Plans.

Enquiries & bookings: Visit the website or email Susan to discuss the most appropriate service for your needs.Sessions may take place outdoors in nature, weather permitting, or in the property's comfortable clinic building.

***For current pricing, availability and funding enquiries, please contact Susan directly.***
📞 Contact Susan - 0409 619 670
Email: wellnesswithhorsesandhumans@gmail.com
Website: https://wellnesswithhorsesandhumans.com.au/


📍 Location
Giles Road, Redland Bay, Queensland 4165
Wellness with Horses & Humans is situated in a peaceful natural setting in the Redlands, approximately 40 minutes from Brisbane CBD and 45 minutes from the Gold Coast.

🌿 A space to slow down, reconnect with nature and explore new possibilities for personal and professional growth.
